title: Software Engineer, Internship - Query Engines
description: A World-Changing Company Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. The Role We are a software engineering team applying open-source data technologies to some of the world's hardest and most important problems. We build the data processing infrastructure that underpins Palantir Foundry, supporting applications that help hospitals care for more patients, help clinical teams coordinate timely diagnoses, and keep essential supplies moving through global disruption. You will work deep inside the systems that make this possible: how computations are represented, how query plans are optimised, how operators execute, and how data is read and written efficiently. We build on and extend Apache Spark, Apache DataFusion, and Apache Iceberg, bringing advances in open-source engines and table formats into the demanding environments our customers operate in. Our work serves many products and workloads across Foundry, including no-code pipelines, interactive analysis, and the processing that keeps the Ontology up to date. Working alongside experienced engineers, you will take on real problems in our production systems. That could mean writing a new planning rule, adding a capability to a native execution engine, or making large tables faster to scan. You will see your work through design, code review, testing, and release. Correctness, compatibility, and predictable performance are central to everything we build, and you will learn how to deliver all three. Join us if you want to learn how modern data systems work from the inside and apply that knowledge to consequential problems. Technologies We Use Java, Scala, Rust, and Python Apache Spark, Apache DataFusion, Apache Comet, and Velox for data processing and query execution Apache Iceberg for table management and catalog interoperability Apache Arrow and Apache Parquet for in-memory data processing and columnar storage Gradle and Cargo for builds, and GitHub for collaboration You do not need prior experience with these technologies. We expect you to learn them here. What We Value Curiosity about how data systems work, from query optimisers and execution operators to file formats and distributed processing A high bar for correctness and a willingness to dig until you understand why something behaves the way it does Comfort following a problem across languages, services, and layers of the stack A practical approach to performance, grounded in measurement rather than intuition Eagerness to learn, ask questions, and incorporate feedback Interest in applying deep systems engineering to real-world problems, with empathy for the people who depend on our software What We Require Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, or a similar field, or equivalent practical experience Proficiency in at least one language such as Java, Rust, Scala, C++, or C Strong foundations in algorithms, data structures, and concurrency Strong written and verbal communication skills Coursework or projects in databases, compilers, operating systems, or distributed systems Contributions to open-source projects Must be planning on graduating in 2028. This should be your final internship before graduating.

title: Business Development Representative, UK&I
description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the role

Vercel is looking for a Strategic Vercel Development Representative (VDR) to join our Sales team. Strategic VDRs are key to our product adoption and company growth in the largest companies in the world. In this autonomous role, you will be building a pipeline of qualified business for the Strategic part of our sales organization through cold outbound and working closely with your counterparts on the Enterprise Account Executive (SAE) team. You will also be collaborating cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success to learn more about product, positioning, and messaging.

The SDR team reaches out to potential customers to introduce them to the value Vercel could bring their business to set up qualified meetings for the Strategic Account Executive Team.  This team initiates substantial transformations for our customers, leading to promotions and profits for customers who adopt Vercel.

If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. 

What you'll do

  • Kick off sales cycles by identifying and qualifying future customers in assigned geo and Enterprise market segment
  • Write tailored messages and cold call qualified prospects
  • Set and book qualified meetings for Enterprise AEs
  • Work closely with Enterprise AEs on targeting some of the largest companies and logos
  • Collaborate with your peers and guide those around you

What you need

  • Ability to navigate and prospect into large org structures in the Fortune 500
  • 1+ years of experience as an outbound SDR
  • Highly creative with outbound approach

Bonus if you

  • Vercel, Next.js, or any other technical background or understanding
  • Salesforce, Outreach, HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation package, including equity.
  • Inclusive Healthcare Package.
  • Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
  • Flexible Time Off.
  • We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

  • Privacy: Please review our Job Applicant for more information on how we handle your data.
  • Equal Opportunity: Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

title: Intern Deployment Engineer - Data & AI
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact — understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our team pairs deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role

As an intern, you will have the unique opportunity to learn and grow through hands-on experiences. Your role will involve utilizing our cutting-edge AI deployment tools to develop innovative solutions for our customers, together with more experienced Deployment Engineers.

This is not a traditional engineering role where you build everything manually. You will be introduced to AI-augmented and business-focused software delivery: helping specify what needs to be built, learning to direct AI agents to execute, and assisting in validating the results. Participation in team meetings and workshops will offer valuable insights into the decision-making process within the company.

The Work You’ll Do

Initiate and Connect

  • Conduct customer-facing sessions with experienced Deployment Engineers to discuss ongoing projects, translate strategic objectives into use cases, and receive guidance on best practices.
  • Assist in gathering and organizing relevant data from various sources, ensuring data accuracy and consistency for analysis.

Build

  • Learn to direct AI deployment agents (like Apollo) to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards by helping to write clear specifications.
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis, utilizing Celonis and other tools to uncover trends, process inefficiencies, and root causes.
  • Assist in defining the initial solution design blueprint and configuring operational solutions across the platform.

Value & Rollout

  • Support the validation of AI-generated outputs for accuracy and business relevance alongside senior team members.
  • Help develop and maintain KPIs to track the success of project initiatives and quantify business impact.
  • Assist in documenting solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and customer handover.

What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era

  • You will learn to work with AI agents as your primary tools, focusing on validating and refining their output rather than writing every line of code manually.
  • You will develop foundational specification and context engineering skills to help translate business needs into precise AI instructions.
  • As you navigate a fast-paced environment, you will learn how to adapt quickly to changes and new approaches as AI capabilities evolve.

The Qualifications You Need

  • Student of Technology Management, Business (-Informatics), Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a comparable degree program with outstanding performance.
  • Know-how in Business Intelligence, data analytics, and a foundational understanding of enterprise business processes.
  • Experience in programming and working with databases; knowledge in SQL, Python, or related coding- and/or database query languages.
  • Curiosity and basic familiarity with AI-assisted development tools, coupled with an eagerness to learn prompt/context engineering.
  • Interest in working with customers, along with awesome presentation and communication skills.
  • Ability to demonstrate initiative, work independently, and think outside of the box.
  • Fluent in English and German (any additional language is a plus).
  • At least 5 months of full-time availability.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

title: Customer Value Architect, EMEA
description:
About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com.

About the Role

Not a technical role, despite 'architect' in the title, this is relationship and strategy work, not engineering. Customer success, account management, or consulting backgrounds are a better fit than technical ones.

The right candidate is a relationship-first advisor who thrives on connecting customers' Mixpanel investment to real business outcomes. You'll be the consultative owner of adoption, value, and AI maturity across a named portfolio of high-value accounts, engaged from onboarding through the full contract lifecycle. You are accountable for the outcome, not the commercial relationship owning the value case and the adoption plan behind it. You will build the executive relationships and strategic plans that make Mixpanel indispensable to how your customers build products.

Responsibilities

  • Connect mixpanel to customer value
    • Own our value workstream with customers - understanding the business challenges that led them to buy Mixpanel, how they measure the ROI of their investment, and ensuring that they achieve that ROI by working across the customers’ teams and collaborating internally with other Mixpanel teams.
    • Build and own relationships across business and technical stakeholders, including executive sponsors, aligning Mixpanel's capabilities to customers' highest-priority goals.
    • Develop and execute success plans that map customer business objectives to adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
    • Perform ongoing discovery of the customer’s business priorities, internal toolset, and ongoing business pain – synthesize this information into actions that feed your success plans and share information with internal partners as needed.
    • Operate in lockstep with the AE and renewal team, with clear lanes: you partner with the AE on expansion and growth motions and with the renewal team on renewal execution, bringing the value case and adoption evidence that underpins both. You own the value case; they own the commercial outcome.
  • Own value delivery and product relationship 
    • Lead customer enablement sessions—covering topics like dashboard design, funnel analysis, and retention modeling—to grow Mixpanel usage depth and breadth across the customer organization.
    • Proactively monitor product usage and health signals; lead regular business reviews to surface insights, deepen adoption, and surface risk early.
    • Drive customer adoption - both identifying new pockets for Mixpanel usage within an organization and strategies for re-engagement where adoption is low.
    • Identify underutilized features and contracted capabilities, translating them into concrete recommendations that expand customer value.
    • Triage customer product requests and issues - solving their use case questions, basic troubleshooting and escalating as appropriate
  • Own the AI Conversation
    • Assess a customer's AI maturity and advise on their agent and context strategy, this is now a first-class part of the job, not a bonus skill.
    • Fluently use Mixpanel's own AI surface (Mixpanel AI, Mixpanel Agent, Headless, and MCP) to help customers building AI-native workflows on their product data.
    • Use AI as a personal operating habit: a rehearsal partner for executive conversations, a discovery-prep engine and stakeholder sentiment analysis.
  • Be the voice of the customer to cross-functional partners
    • Coordinate across GTM, Product, and Engineering to manage escalations, advocate for customer needs, and bring the right resources to bear.
    • Contribute to team playbooks and best practices that scale impact across the broader CS organization.

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • Experience in Customer Success, management consulting, or a related field supporting complex B2B SaaS accounts.
  • A track record of managing relationships at every level across different functions (from business executives to technical ICs) and influencing decisions at the C-suite level.
  • The ability to translate technical concepts—data models, analytics instrumentation, product metrics—into business terms that resonate with non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive platform adoption and connect product usage to customer business outcomes.
  • Experience building and executing strategic value and adoption plans – tying day-to-day activities to strategic outcomes and being able to communicate wins in terms of ROI.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic or AI-native tooling. MCP-based workflows, LLM copilots, or similar (beyond casual ChatGPT use.)

Bonus Points For

  • Background in product analytics, growth, or data-driven product development.
  • Experience in a technical advisory or solutions capacity (e.g., implementation, professional services).
  • Familiarity with analytics instrumentation, event tracking, or data tooling.

#LI-Hybrid

Benefits and Perks

  • Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care
  • Mental Wellness Benefit
  • Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays
  • Enhanced Parental Leave
  • Volunteer Time Off
  • Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break

*please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary*

Culture Values

  • Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.
  • Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.
  • One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.
  • Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.
  • Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.
  • Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.

Why choose Mixpanel?

We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.

Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance or other similar laws that may be applicable, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We’ve immersed ourselves in our Culture and Values as our guiding principles for the impact we want to have and the future we are building.

title: AI Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

AI Enablement builds Raisin's internal AI platform. We make it easy and safe for every team, from engineering and product to business operations, to use AI in their daily work and in the products they build.

We provide the shared foundation for that: governed access to AI models and tools, the controls that keep data secure and usage auditable, and the visibility teams need to run AI reliably and cost-effectively. We also shape how Raisin builds software with AI, from AI-assisted coding to agentic workflows that support teams across the development lifecycle. Because Raisin operates in regulated financial services, security and compliance are core to how we design the platform.

You will join early and help shape how AI is used across Raisin.


Your Responsibilities

As an AI Platform Engineer, you build and run the platform that lets teams use AI safely, and you help engineering teams bring AI into how they build software. You own your work from the first design to production and work directly with the people who use it. You won't do all of the following at once: you will go deep in a few areas and contribute to the rest.

Build and run the platform

  • Design, build, and operate shared services that give teams governed access to AI models and tools, including authentication, routing across providers, usage limits, guardrails, and audit logging.
  • Build safe ways for AI agents to connect to internal systems and data, with clear identity, permissions, and review.
  • Run what you build in production: infrastructure as code, observability for reliability, usage, and cost, and incident response.

Bring AI into how we build software

  • Design and build agentic workflows that support engineers across the development lifecycle, from planning and implementation to code review, testing, and release.
  • Create reusable building blocks for AI tools, such as agent instructions, skills, and integrations with engineering systems, that teams can adopt and extend.
  • Help engineering teams adopt AI-assisted development in a way that improves quality as well as speed, and measure the effect on delivery.

Treat the platform as a product for internal customers

  • Work with engineers, product managers, and business teams to understand their needs and turn them into platform capabilities.
  • Make the platform and its tools easy to adopt through self-service, sensible defaults, and clear documentation.
  • Measure adoption, reliability, cost, and impact, and use that data to decide what to build next.

Own technical decisions

  • Lead the design of new capabilities from first idea to production, including build-versus-buy choices, and document decisions so others can follow the reasoning.
  • Work with security, legal, and compliance colleagues to turn their requirements into controls the platform enforces automatically.
  • Make principled model choices based on cost, latency, and quality.
  • Raise the bar for the engineers around you through design reviews, pairing, and sharing what you learn.

 

Your Profile

What you bring

  • 5+ years as a software engineer in backend, platform, or infrastructure roles, including production systems that other teams depend on.
  • Experience building for internal customers: a platform, developer tooling, or shared services used by other engineers.
  • Strong skills in at least one programming language (Python preferred; TypeScript and JVM languages also relevant).
  • Solid cloud and delivery fundamentals: AWS or another major cloud, containers, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD.
  • Practical experience with LLM APIs or AI tooling beyond experiments, and you use AI coding assistants in your daily work.
  • You are comfortable with evolving scope, make pragmatic trade-offs, and explain them clearly to technical and non-technical colleagues.

Nice to have

  • Experience with LLM gateways, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), managed model services, or agent runtimes.
  • You have rolled out AI-assisted development workflows for other engineers, such as agent instructions, reusable skills, or automated code review.
  • Identity and access: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, SSO, role-based access control, or delegated access.
  • API gateways, rate limiting, multi-tenant isolation, or observability (OpenTelemetry or similar).
  • A feel for the cost, latency, and quality trade-offs of different models.

You don't need to tick every box. If you have strong platform or developer-tooling experience and real curiosity about AI, we would like to hear from you.

description: Back to all jobsSenior Product Data Analyst- Consumer GrowthLondon, England, United Kingdom · Data & AnalyticsLoadingApply nowSumUp | Senior Data Analyst - Consumer Growth | London, United KingdomCompetitive salary · Office-firstThis role does not support Visa sponsorship and candidates must have the right to work in the UK. About the teamSumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translatesIf you want to be the person leadership turns to for an honest read of the business, and to see your analysis change real product and commercial decisions, this role is for you. What you'll do Shape commercial decisions Own the SumUp Consumer KPI framework end to end — defining which metrics matter, how they're measured and how they connect customer behaviour to commercial outcomes. Evaluate the quality of our growth: CAC, source attribution, channel performance and downstream customer value, separating headline growth from sustainable growth. Work with Risk and Anti-Fraud so fraud, abuse and economic loss are built into how we judge customers, channels and markets. Drive product decisions Diagnose where customers drop out between acquisition and activation, and which behaviours drive repeat usage, retention and lifetime value. Design and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer and commercial impact. Help Product Managers size opportunities and judge whether shipped features delivered the outcomes they promised. Influence with data Act as an independent analytical partner to Consumer leadership and to Product, Growth, Finance and Risk — proactively surfacing trends, risks and opportunities rather than waiting for requests. Challenge assumptions, metric definitions and interpretations constructively when the evidence points elsewhere. Build trusted reporting and help teams self-serve routine questions, so your time goes on the problems that matter most. Use AI and LLM-assisted techniques to speed up analysis, customer understanding and insight generation. You'll be great for this role if… You form your own view of why something happened and what the business should do about it — not just report what happened. You've influenced senior stakeholders with data, including changing a decision or overturning a long-held assumption. You understand the economics of a digital consumer product: acquisition, activation, retention, churn, customer lifetime value and unit economics. You're fluent in product analytics — funnel, cohort, segmentation and behavioural analysis. You have strong SQL and are comfortable querying, analysing and validating data in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or similar. You use a visualisation tool such as Tableau, Looker or Power BI to build reporting that stakeholders actually rely on. You turn ambiguous questions into structured analysis and tell a clear, concise story to technical and non technical audiences alike. You prioritise by business impact and are comfortable managing several stakeholders and workstreams at once. Bonus points if you have: Experience in consumer fintech, banking, payments or financial services Growth or marketing analytics experience, including attribution, CAC and channel performance (e.g. AppsFlyer, Google Analytics) Experience modelling customer lifetime value or unit economics Experience partnering with fraud, abuse or risk teams Depth in experimentation design and the statistics behind it Familiarity with dbt or experience working alongside Analytics Engineers Python or R for advanced analysis Why you should join SumUp🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our central London Bridge location, wrapped in historic charm and modern flair. This involves an office-first setup🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave, plus bank holidays and special leaves📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education🏥 Health matters: private health insurance, including optical and dental🚗 Life made easier: salary-sacrifice commuter benefits via Gogeta💼 Financial security: retirement scheme (SumUp matches 7% when you contribute 5%)🛡 Peace of mind: life insurance from MetLife for 2× your salary🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team About SumUpBe empowered to do more that matters.At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. title: Partner Lead, EMEA
description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the role

The Partner team at Vercel is charged with accelerating our growth with partners. As a Partner Lead, EMEA, you will play a pivotal role in helping to establish and grow our partner ecosystem with Technology and Solution partners.

This is a senior individual contributor role for a builder. You will define the strategy, activate priority partners, and generate meaningful partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline. You’ll work cross-functionally across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Leadership to establish Vercel as a strategic platform within the EMEA ecosystem.

If you are energized by creating net-new revenue streams, shaping GTM strategy with partners, and turning early-stage relationships into scaled growth engines, this role is for you.

What you'll do

Build and Scale the EMEA Partner Ecosystem

  • Define and execute Vercel’s regional partner strategy across EMEA-wide Technology and Solution partners.
  • Identify, recruit, and activate high-impact regional and global partners, including regional GSIs and strategic ISVs at the regional level.
  • Establish scalable engagement models and joint value propositions that drive measurable pipeline and revenue.

Drive Partner-Sourced & Influenced Revenue

  • Develop joint GTM plans with partners to generate partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline.
  • Lead co-sell motions, account mapping, and opportunity acceleration in partnership with regional Sales leaders.
  • Own revenue targets tied to partner performance and ecosystem contribution.

Develop Strategic Relationships

  • Build executive-level relationships with alliance leaders, practice heads, and GTM stakeholders.
  • Serve as the primary point of accountability for strategic partner success in EMEA. Align partner objectives with Vercel’s growth priorities.

Solution & Offering Development

  • Collaborate with Solution partners to package and bring Vercel’s AI Cloud and frontend platform offerings to market.
  • Identify repeatable use cases, industry plays, and reference architectures that unlock scale.
  • Provide structured feedback to Product and Marketing based on regional partner and customer insights.

Enablement & Ecosystem Activation

  • Lead partner enablement initiatives to ensure technical, sales, and marketing readiness.
  • Equip partners with messaging, positioning, and use-case clarity to successfully sell Vercel.
  • Represent the EMEA partner voice internally and ensure alignment across teams.

What you need

  • 7+ years in business development, partner management, and/or sales roles at a high-growth tech company.
  • Proven track record of building partner-sourced pipeline from zero to multi-million-dollar impact.
  • Strong understanding of frontend technologies, cloud infrastructure, and AI development ecosystems.
  • Existing EMEA partner network (agencies, GSIs, hyperscalers, technology partners) that you can activate.
  • Experience driving co-sell motions and working closely with regional sales teams.
  • Executive presence with the ability to influence senior stakeholders internally and externally.
  • Highly collaborative, action-oriented, and motivated by exceeding ambitious growth targets.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation package, including equity.
  • Inclusive Healthcare Package.
  • Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
  • Flexible Time Off.
  • We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

 

Disclosures:

  • Privacy: Please review our Job Applicant for more information on how we handle your data.
  • Equal Opportunity: Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

title: Manager, Global Payroll
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Finance team
The Finance team ensures Affirm remains financially sound and strategically positioned for growth. Our team manages financial planning, accounting, pricing, vendor management, tax, investor relations, and corporate development. We deliver timely insights, accurate reporting, and careful analysis to support decision-making. From day-to-day financial operations to major investments, we enable sustainable, informed growth by maintaining strong fiscal discipline.

About the role

Our Global Payroll Team is a critical function within Affirm, dedicated to delivering accurate, timely, and compliant payroll services for Affirmers across multiple countries and regions. We partner closely with People Operations, People Tech, Global Mobility, Accounting, Tax, Legal, and external payroll providers to ensure a seamless employee experience while maintaining adherence to local labor laws, tax regulations, and company policies.

As a global team, we embrace collaboration, continuous improvement, and operational excellence. We leverage technology, standardized processes, and strong governance practices to manage the complexities of international payroll while supporting a diverse and growing workforce. Our commitment to accuracy, confidentiality, and customer service enables us to provide reliable payroll solutions that support both employees and business objectives.

Joining our Global Payroll Team means becoming part of a dynamic, fast-paced environment where your expertise will directly contribute to employee satisfaction, regulatory compliance, and the success of our global operations. We value innovation, attention to detail, and a proactive mindset, empowering team members to drive process improvements and make a meaningful impact on a worldwide scale.

What you'll do

  • In this role you will be reporting to the Senior Manager, Global Payroll.

  • Collaborate with the People Platform, Benefits, Legal, and Finance business units on all payroll matters with cross-functional impact such as accurate benefit information, new joiner processes, cash, bonus, process leavers, and other ad hoc projects impacting payroll.

  • Process U.K. and Spain payroll.  This role will grow with additional EU countries under our high growth model.

  • Assist with processing RSUs and ESPP earnings and taxation.

  • Process garnishments and levies.

  • Assist with audit and compliance procedures related to payroll. 

  • Support the month-end closing for all payroll related accounts. 

  • Assist with annual financial statement audit and be the primary contact for all payroll related audit testing for respective countries.

  • Conduct year-end reporting for respective countries.

  • Answer employee questions regarding pay, benefits, etc.

What we look for

  • Minimum 10-15 years of international payroll experience with a focus on EMEA countries.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent training and education beyond high school.

  • Strong math, analytical, research, problem-solving and critical thinking skills.

  • Strong system and data flow knowledge. Ability to learn and adapt to new process flows and software technologies.

  • Self-motivated, flexible, deadline-oriented and able to complete tasks with limited supervision.

  • Ability to think creatively and critically and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic, and often ambiguous work environment.

  • Excellent communication skills to include written and verbal communication with employees and across the organization including varying levels of leadership.

  • Experience with systems migration and integration of different systems is a plus.

  • Knowledge of NetSuite or Workday is a plus.

Base Pay Grade - K

Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

GBR base pay range per year: £88,000 - £136,000

#LI-Remote

Remote-first with flexibility built in
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

title: Agentic AI Principal
description: We are looking for an Agentic AI Principal to act as a senior technical authority and trusted client advisor for complex agentic AI transformation in Germany, the Netherlands and the wider DACH region. Operating at Principal level, you will shape enterprise AI strategy, define agentic architecture blueprints, lead high-value C-suite engagements and guide complex programmes from opportunity through delivery. You will bring deep hands-on credibility in multi-agent systems, governance and safeguards, while setting reusable patterns and raising capability across teams. The role has particular focus on sovereign, compliant and production-grade agentic AI for regulated German, Dutch and European enterprises, with a primary focus on healthcare and life sciences (pharma, biotech, medtech and healthcare providers). Experience from other regulated sectors, such as financial services and insurance, automotive and manufacturing, energy and telecommunications, is equally welcome. Our delivery model is moving from large time-and-materials teams to small, AI-first, multidisciplinary pods accountable to a business outcome. You will anchor the agentic side of that work, pairing with our data, tech advisory and industry domain leads from presale through delivery. This is a client-facing, builder's leadership role. You will start with a small, senior team and grow it through technical depth, delivery excellence and thought leadership, rather than inheriting a large organisation.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Identity International)
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm’s Identity team is mission-critical to the customer checkout experience. When a customer chooses Affirm, one of the first steps is an identity check, and our ability to make the right decision directly impacts conversion, revenue, fraud exposure, and regulatory compliance. Our team owns Identity for all markets outside North America, playing a key role in Affirm’s international expansion. We are responsible for KYC, user lifecycle management, and identity decisioning across multiple regulatory environments. This work is about shaping how Affirm adapts its core Identity platform to new market dynamics, customer expectations, and compliance requirements.

We are a team of six engineers based across Spain and Poland. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can turn ambiguous business and customer problems into reliable, well-designed technical solutions.

In this role, you will help shape our quarterly technical direction, translate team goals into concrete projects, and identify cross-cutting risks, tradeoffs, and opportunities. You should be comfortable designing across system boundaries, driving collaboration with partner teams, and advocating for technical investments that improve long-term execution. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership beyond shipping code: raising code quality and review standards, making performance, availability, and scale tradeoffs explicit, and improving the operational health of the systems they own. You’ll help reduce toil, create useful playbooks, mentor engineers, support new hires and interns, and contribute to high-signal hiring.

Most importantly, we’re excited to work with someone who leaves things better than they found them, communicates clearly across audiences, uses customer feedback to influence technical plans, and helps the team continuously improve.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on coding role where feature velocity and operational excellence go hand-in-hand. You’ll spend most of your week in the codebase - leveraging AI tools to write robust Kotlin and Python, ship impactful features, investigate complex production issues, and keep our systems rock-solid and reliable. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for someone who wants to work on foundational systems that directly enable Affirm’s global growth.

What You'll Do

· You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers on your team through ambiguity to solve open-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery.
· You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.

· You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.

· You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes.
· You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
· You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely.

title: Senior Payments Partnerships Manager - Visa
description:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Senior Partnerships Manager - Visa

Adyen is looking for a Senior Partnerships Manager who will advance Adyen’s strategy and agenda with Visa globally. In this role, you will lead high-impact Visa partnerships for Adyen and use your expertise and influence to build strong inroads across their global organization. You will serve as a recognized subject matter expert whose insights help shape our partnership strategy, while working together with a broad range of senior cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Commercial, and Finance teams.

This is a full-time position based in our London or Amsterdam office reporting into our Head of Card Network & Product Partnerships.

What you’ll do

  • Strategic Partnership Management: Build and nurture deep global relationships with Visa across all levels. Architect and execute multi-year strategic plans for key initiatives and establish partnership frameworks to ensure Adyen remains at the forefront of payments innovation
  • Deliver High-Impact Outcomes: Drive breakthrough commercial performance and long-term financial scalability for our Visa portfolio. Solve complex, ambiguous payment ecosystem challenges by leveraging deep analytical insight into scheme economics, scheme fees, and incentive structures
  • Product Strategy & Innovation: Serve as a key strategic advisor to Product. Deeply shape our product roadmap through expert network insights and the co-creation of novel joint solutions across card acquiring, issuing, and digital payment technologies
  • Cross-Functional Leadership & GTM: Lead complex cross-functional initiatives across commercial, product, finance, and legal teams to execute high-stakes go-to-market strategies and support major merchant opportunities globally
  • Thought Leadership & Mentorship: Act as a thought leader and mentor for Partnership Managers across the organization. Lead strategic internal projects that elevate Adyen’s partnership capabilities and industry reputation 

Who you are

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in strategic partnerships or business development in the payments industry, with a track record of handling complex global relationships
  • Possess strong domain expertise across card acquiring and issuing, together with a strong understanding of payment ecosystem dynamics
  • Proven success in negotiating complex, multi-year bespoke agreements together with global card network and/or fintech partners
  • Demonstrated ability to translate ecosystem trends into clear commercial models and actionable insights
  • Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, together with the ability to influence both internal and external leadership across different functions
  • Comfortable operating with extensive autonomy in a fast-paced environment, with a track record of inspiring virtual cross-functional teams without direct authority
  • An MBA or equivalent advanced degree is strongly preferred
  • Full professional proficiency (written and verbal) in English

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen. 

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

This role is based out of our London or Amsterdam office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

title: Software Engineer Intern (London, United Kingdom) (Summer 2027)
description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We’re looking for software engineering interns who are excited to make an impact across different layers of our product and infrastructure. At Figma, we pair interns with teams that align with their skills and interests. This year, we're inviting you to share your interests from the start, so we can create the strongest possible match.

Our interns are embedded into small, collaborative engineering teams across the company. You’ll work closely with your mentor and teammates to ship meaningful features, tools, or systems. Whether you're working on internal infrastructure or user-facing features, you’ll get to learn, contribute, and grow in a supportive environment.

This internship will be based out of our London Hub with a 5/3, 5/17, 6/1 or 6/14 start date.

Engineering Interests at Figma:

When you apply, you'll tell us which areas you're most interested in to help us understand which kinds of engineering work you're most excited about:

  1. Product: Build full stack user facing features, including new collaboration tools, new product workflows, growth oriented experiments, and more
  2. Platform/Infrastructure: Build platform level tools, including distributed systems, developer tooling, performance/scalability work, and more
  3. Security Engineering: Build security-focused systems, product security tooling, detection, secure infrastructure, or privacy/security features
  4. Open: I’m flexible and still exploring different types of work

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Join a small engineering team as a full member of the team, with your own project and mentor
  • Contribute to projects that directly align with team goals and impact
  • Collaborate with engineers, PMs, designers, and QA to break down features and plan timelines
  • Build, document, and maintain tests, features, or infrastructure
  • Share feedback and participate in peer code review
  • Ship your project(s) by the end of your internship!

Some past intern projects:

  • Diagramming improvements in FigJam
  • Smart selection
  • Shared fonts

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • Experience writing clean code in at least one general-purpose language (e.g. C++, JavaScript, Python, Java, etc.), with a solid grasp of core CS concepts like data structures and algorithms
  • Experience solving technical problems through school, work, or personal projects
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to write, debug, and optimize code
  • Demonstrated curiosity about how systems are designed and operate, from infrastructure to UI
  • Strong communicator who asks great questions, collaborates well with others, and is excited to learn, get feedback, and grow as an engineer

At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please reach out to accommodations-ext@figma.com. These modifications enable an individual with a disability to have an equal opportunity not only to get a job, but successfully perform their job tasks to the same extent as people without disabilities. 

Examples of accommodations include but are not limited to: 

  • Holding interviews in an accessible location
  • Enabling closed captioning on video conferencing

title: Principal, EMEA Sales Strategy and Operations
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: London, the UK

About the Role: 

As the Principal, EMEA Sales Strategy and Operations, you will lead the operational strategy and execution for two of our most important regions in EMEA. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Sales Strategy and Operation for EMEA, you will partner closely with regional sales leadership, global sales operations, marketing, finance, and other cross-functional teams to drive sales productivity, accelerate pipeline growth, and enhance forecasting accuracy.

You will identify, design, and execute strategies that improve performance, scalability, and operational excellence across UKI, CEE and Israel regions. A catalyst for action, you will bring structure, insight, and momentum to a rapidly growing business. The ideal candidate is both process- and data-driven, thrives on collaboration, and knows how to unite teams around a common vision to deliver exceptional results. 

What you'll do

  • Responsibilities:

    • Serve as a business partner to the UKI, CEE and Israel AVPs and Sales Leadership team, defining and driving strategic initiatives that enable the region to achieve its quarterly and annual revenue objectives. You will deliver actionable insights, analytics, and use AI to enhance decision-making, uncover performance bottlenecks, and accelerate sales execution
    • You will work to continuously improve processes, innovate and find scalable solutions to do more with less. You will use AI and automation to improve sales productivity and help leadership look behind corners to anticipate blockers and reduce risks. 
    • Partner with other Regional Leaders, global RevOps, Marketing Ops, Finance and Enablement to ensure regional execution aligns with global go-to-market strategy and expectations
    • Drive forecasting discipline: ensure accurate pipeline coverage, risk identification, deal reviews, and business reviews with regional leadership
    • Monitor region-specific market dynamics and ensure sales operations are tailored to the unique UKI, CEE and Israel environment
    • Own key regional sales operations metrics (e.g., sales cycle length, win rate, pipeline conversion, average deal size, forecasting accuracy, quota attainment) and provide regular reporting to senior leadership and support EMEA sales Strategy and Operations leader to improve cadences.
    • Partner with GTM strategy team and provide input to sales planning, including regular updates to quotas, customer segmentation, account targeting, and Channel development

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

  • Proven senior experience (10+ years) in sales operations, revenue operations or go-to-market operations in a high-growth technology / SaaS company 
  • Experience scaling sales operations across multiple regions (preferably EMEA) including complexity of multiple countries, languages, regulatory frameworks
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data: able to turn data into insights and actions
  • Deep understanding of sales processes/end-to-end sales lifecycle, pipeline management best practices, forecasting, territory/quota design, incentive comp, CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce)
  • Experience to use AI to drive automation, innovation and improve efficiency.
  • Exceptional cross-functional collaboration and influencing skills: ability to partner with sales leadership, marketing, product, finance, enablement and others
  • Excellent communication (verbal & written) — able to articulate complex operational issues and influence senior leadership
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, dynamic, changing environment; strong change-management aptitude
  • Strategic thinking with strong execution orientation

 

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer, Internship
description: Le poste Les Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSE) travaillent directement avec les clients afin de comprendre rapidement leurs problèmes les plus importants et ainsi concevoir et implémenter des solutions qui vont utiliser leurs données afin de résoudre ces problématiques. Nos clients s’appuient sur les plateformes de Palantir pour certaines de leurs opérations les plus critiques, et les projets débutent souvent par une question ouverte, par exemple : « Comment évaluer le risque d’incendie de forêt et, par conséquent, comment optimiser le réseau électrique ? » ou « Comment évaluer rapidement notre chaîne d’approvisionnement alimentaire et l’adapter afin d’apporter à temps une aide vitale ? » En tant que FDSE, vous appliquez votre capacité à résoudre les problèmes, votre créativité et vos compétences techniques pour aider les organisations à exploiter au mieux leurs données et avoir ainsi un impact réel sur le monde. Vous avez l’opportunité d’obtenir des informations rares et de contribuer à certaines des industries et institutions les plus importantes au monde. Responsabilités principales En tant que stagiaire chez FDSE, vos responsabilités s’apparentent à celles que l’on trouve dans une petite start-up, tout en bénéficiant des ressources, de la stabilité et de l’accompagnement d’une entreprise technologique bien établie. Vous travaillerez en petites équipes avec une supervision minimale et serez responsable de l’exécution de bout en bout de projets à enjeux élevés. Votre journée peut consister à discuter de l’architecture avec d’autres ingénieurs, à gérer des données à grande échelle, à coder une application web personnalisée, à discuter avec l’équipe dirigeante du client ou à établir une stratégie pour votre équipe. Les stagiaires FDSE sont traités exactement comme des ingénieurs à temps plein, et bénéficient d’une grande liberté et d’une grande autonomie dans leur travail. Ils assument la responsabilité des projets et des résultats réels sur lesquels nos clients comptent. Nos principes: Impact : nous gérons des projets significatifs et enthousiasmants qui rendent le monde meilleur. Responsabilité : nous menons nos projets du début à la fin, en surmontant tous les obstacles que nous pourrions rencontrer. Nous nous faisons mutuellement confiance afin de gérer efficacement le temps et les priorités et donner aux individus l’espace nécessaire pour réfléchir par eux-mêmes. Collaboration : nous travaillons en interne avec des personnes d’horizons variés, tels que d’autres FDSE, des équipes Produits et des Deployment Strategists. Nous travaillons également en externe avec nos clients, souvent sur site, afin de comprendre et de répondre à leurs problèmes. Développement : nous pensons que l’apprentissage par l’expérience est l’une des meilleures écoles et nous nous encourageons nous-mêmes tout comme nos pairs à rechercher de nouveaux défis et de nouvelles opportunités de croissance, ainsi qu’à trouver de nouvelles façons d’innover et de partager les connaissances. Le profil recherché Propension et intérêt à se déplacer sur les sites client en fonction des besoins. Capacité de passer 25 à 50 % du temps en déplacement de préférence, mais les exigences peuvent varier selon l’équipe et l’emplacement. Capacité démontrée à apprendre continuellement, à travailler de manière autonome et à prendre des décisions avec un minimum de direction. Capacité à collaborer avec des équipes de personnes techniques et non techniques, et à être à l’aise pour travailler dans un environnement en évolution constante avec des objectifs dynamiques et des itérations avec les utilisateurs. Volonté de résoudre de façon créative les problèmes techniques liés aux structures de données, aux systèmes de stockage, à l’infrastructure cloud, aux frameworks front-end et à d’autres outils techniques. Intérêt à travailler avec des données à grande échelle et à les utiliser pour résoudre des problèmes opérationnels importants. Les exigences Expérience en ingénierie, de préférence dans des domaines tels que l’informatique, les mathématiques, le Software Engineering, la physique et la science des données. Maîtrise de langages de programmation tels que Python, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript ou similaire. Vous devez prévoir d’obtenir votre diplôme en 2027. Il doit s’agir de votre dernier stage avant d’obtenir votre diplôme. Pour postuler, veuillez soumettre ce qui suit : Un CV à jour Des réponses réfléchies à nos questions de candidature Date limite de l’offre Afin de renforcer la transparence de notre processus de recrutement, nous aimerions vous faire part de nos attentes concernant la date limite de l’offre. En postulant à ce poste, vous vous engagez à confirmer votre décision dans les deux semaines suivant la réception de votre offre écrite. La vie chez Palantir Nous tenons à ce que chaque Palantirien(ne) atteigne son meilleur potentiel, c’est pourquoi nous célébrons les forces, les compétences et les intérêts des individus, de votre premier entretien à votre croissance à long terme, plutôt que de nous appuyer sur les échelles de carrière traditionnelles. L’attention portée aux besoins de notre communauté nous permet d’optimiser nos possibilités de croissance et contribue à garantir de nombreuses voies de réussite chez Palantir. Promouvoir la santé et le bien-être dans tous les domaines de la vie des Palantiriens n’est que l’une des façons dont nous investissons dans notre communauté. Apprenez-en davantage sur la vie chez Palantir et notez que nos offres peuvent varier selon les régions. Conformément aux valeurs et à la culture de Palantir, nous estimons que les employés sont « meilleurs ensemble » et que le travail en présentiel permet d’obtenir des résultats plus créatifs. En conséquence, nous encourageons les employés à travailler depuis nos bureaux pour favoriser la connectivité et l’innovation. De nombreuses équipes proposent des options hybrides (télétravail un jour ou deux par semaine), ce qui permet à nos employés de trouver le bon compromis pour leur productivité personnelle. En fonction des besoins de l’entreprise, il existe quelques postes qui permettent de travailler « à distance » de manière exceptionnelle. Si vous postulez à l’un de ces postes, vous devez travailler depuis la ville et/ou le pays dans lequel vous êtes employé(e). Si le poste précise « sur site », vous devez travailler depuis un bureau. Si vous souhaitez donner aux organisations les plus importantes au monde les moyens d’agir, votre place est ici. Palantir valorise l’excellence, d’où qu’elle vienne. Nous nous engageons à rendre le processus de candidature et d’embauche accessible à tous et offrirons des aménagements raisonnables aux personnes vivant en situation de handicap. Si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement pour le processus de candidature ou d’embauche, veuillez nous contacter et nous indiquer comment nous pouvons vous aider. Attention : il ne vous sera jamais demandé d’envoyer un paiement ou de partager des données financières pour participer à notre processus d’entretien. Si vous pensez avoir été contacté par un escroc, nous vous conseillons de cesser toute communication avec la personne et d’envisager de la signaler aux autorités compétentes, telles que l’Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3) du FBI aux États-Unis.

title: HR Application Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

The People Solutions team serves as the strategic engine room of Raisin’s People & Culture team by building a secure, data-driven, and compliant infrastructure that scales the organization. By bridging the gap between strategy and technology, the team optimizes HRIS systems to eliminate manual work, leverages analytics and AI to drive smarter business decisions, and acts as a compliance anchor managing audits, policies, and risk.

Your Responsibilities

  • We are looking for a People Application Manager to own the administration of Raisin’s People applications.
  • You will ensure smooth operations of the HRIS and its connected applications and be the main point of contact for incident resolution with our People tooling stack.
  • You will configure Raisin’s People applications to meet the business needs based on the requirements of the People business functions and in close alignment with the People Solutions leadership.
  • You will look after the automated account onboarding and IAM of the People applications.
  • You will support seamless integrations of Raisin’s People applications in close alignment with People Solutions leadership and other stakeholders such as the Enterprise IT team.
  • You will own the documentation of configuration and customisation of Raisin’s People applications and their interfaces.

Your Profile

  • You hold a university degree in Computer Science, or a related field, or bring equivalent experience with a strong analytical background.
  • You have 3+ years of hands-on experience in IT support or application management.
  • You are able to manage incidents and tasks within SLAs.
  • You have strong People domain knowledge incl. People process across the employee lifecycle.
  • You are highly responsible, trustworthy, and adept at handling sensitive and confidential data with the utmost discretion.
  • You have strong communication skills and you feel comfortable collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You are fluent in English (German would be a plus).
  • Experience with our tooling stack (especially with Personio) is a plus.

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from

  • Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.
  • Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.
  • A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.
  • Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidise your membership with more than €20 per month. 
  • Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidise with €25 per month.
  • Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.
  • Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.
  • You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation.

Raisin Applicant

We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.
