title: Software Engineer – Query Engines
description: A World-Changing Company Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. The Role Backend Software Engineers at Palantir build software at scale to transform how organisations use data. Our Software Engineers are involved throughout the product lifecycle, from idea generation, design, prototyping, and production delivery. You will collaborate closely with technical and non-technical teammates to understand our customers' problems and build products that solve them. We encourage movement across teams to share context, skills, and experience, so you'll learn about many different technologies and aspects of each product. Engineers work autonomously and make decisions independently, within a community that will support and challenge you as you grow and develop, becoming a strong technical contributor and engineering leader. Your day-to-day workflow will vary, adapting to the requirements of our users and the technical challenges that arise. One day, you may find yourself collaborating with other engineers to architect a new system that enables a novel workflow, the next you could be fine-tuning performance to enable low-latency operational outcomes. Our Product Development organisation is made up of small teams of Software Engineers. Each team focuses on a specific aspect of a product and work collaboratively to build cross functional capabilities, streamline user workflows and continuously improve our software's efficiency and reliability. We’re hiring engineers who are passionate about solving real-world problems and empowering both developers and end-users to work optimally. If you’re motivated to develop reliable, performant, and scalable systems, and to design robust APIs and primitives, this role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our products and the people who use them. Frontline Foundry Software Engineers may be offered the opportunity to Frontline, an exclusive program unlike any other. This unique, short-term assignment involves being embedded with customers, allowing you to work directly with users and gain firsthand insight into how our products are used and the challenges our customers face. Unlike traditional engineering roles, Frontline immerses you in complex, ambiguous problems, empowering you to deliver impactful solutions across some of the world’s most important industries and institutions. Some of our most successful products were built on the factory floor, addressing real-world problems for the world's most important institutions. These products were developed by some of our most successful product engineers, who began their careers in roles aligned with Frontline responsibilities, gaining a deep understanding of both our technology and our customers. Frontliners operate across a broad spectrum of responsibilities, much like a startup CTO. They work in small teams to own the end-to-end execution of high-stakes projects. This spectrum ranges from discussing architecture and building custom web apps to conducting workshops with users and strategizing with customer executives. No two days are alike, as each day is diverse and impactful. By witnessing how customers engage with Foundry and experiencing these pain points firsthand, you’ll gain unique insights that feed directly back into our development process, helping to refine and enhance our products. title: Analyst II, Credit
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

As a Merchant Risk Analyst, you will assess financial risk related to credit, fraud and identity associated with the merchants. You will also coordinate with cross-functional partners to assess non-financial risk – brand, reputational, legal and compliance risk.

The ideal candidate will have knowledge or experience in e-commerce underwriting and/or commercial lending. They will also have a solid understanding of evaluating merchant financial risk based on 3rd party data, credit reports, and other merchant attributes. Prior work experience in payments, lending, banking or financial institutions is a plus!

 

What you’ll do

  • Assess brand, compliance, fraud and financial risk and determine credit exposure risk on new and existing merchants

  • Use business credit reports, financial documents, investigative research tools, and financial market data to conduct risk assessment of Affirm’s merchants

  • Investigate and use new sources of third party data to assess merchant financial risk

  • Conduct ongoing monitoring of credit, fraud, and dispute/chargeback trends by merchants

  • Business Improvement In Execution: Leverage your knowledge to provide guidance towards the automation/improvements of merchant risk evaluation

 

What we look for

  • 3+ years of experience in assessing merchant risk in a function such as Merchant/Seller Risk Management, Fraud, Collections, or Merchant Underwriting

  • Experience working with cross functional partners across the organization, especially Sales and Business Development teams

  • Experience reviewing financial documents, business credit reports and payment processor statements

  • Ownership mentality: Demonstrate an appropriate sense of accountability, ownership, urgency and execution


Compensation & Benefits

Base Pay Grade - G

Equity Grade - 3

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidised medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

Base pay range per year: £66,000 - £76,000 

Location: UK Remote

Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

title: Director, International Communications
description: MKTQ427R39 The Role Databricks is hiring a Director of International Communications to build and scale our global communications strategy. As Databricks grows its footprint, this role will own how that story gets told: new market entries, in-country investments, new offices, customer wins, and local business milestones that build Databricks' reputation market by market. This role will serve as a strategic communications advisor to regional and country leaders in Europe, Asia, and the Americas and will be responsible for the execution of communications programs across those regions. This is a strategic role: turning business momentum into locally resonant news that establishes Databricks as a leader in data and AI around the world. What This Role Unlocks Communications advisor to regional leaders – advise on PR, social, internal comms strategy Regional news at scale — a dedicated strategy for translating business growth across Europe, Asia, and the Americas into press moments. Local relevance, global consistency — an approach tailored to each region's media landscape while staying true to Databricks' global product and corporate narrative. Strong in-market presence — deep relationships with regional leadership, agencies, and field teams. Leadership for regional PR teams — a dedicated manager and mentor for our international communications leads while building close relationships with U.S. based comms and product leaders. The Impact You Will Have Regional Communications Strategy Own Databricks' international communications strategy across three regions: Europe, Asia, and the Americas (13 countries). Spot and drive market-specific news — expansions, investments, new offices, customer milestones, and partnerships — that builds Databricks' profile in each country. Evolve the communications strategy as the business scales into new and existing regions. Regional Partnership Serve as the connective tissue between global communications strategy and on-the-ground business momentum in every region. Partner with regional business leaders, ensuring strategy reflects local business priorities. Partner with field marketing and country managers to identify stories worth telling on the ground Team Leadership & Agency/Media Relationships Manage and support Databricks' communications leads internationally; set clear direction and priorities while providing the autonomy to run their markets. Manage PR agency relationships across all 13 covered markets. Build direct relationships with key regional media so each market has the storytelling support it needs to land Databricks' news locally. What We Look For 12+ years of experience in international, regional, or global communications, ideally in enterprise software, cloud, or AI. Proven track record building regional press strategies and driving coverage across multiple international markets. Strong people management experience, with a track record of developing communications professionals across international teams. Experience managing PR agencies across diverse regions and media landscapes. Strong relationship-building skills with senior business leaders and field teams. Sharp news judgment — able to spot and shape a story from business developments like market entries, customer wins, or new offices. Comfort operating across time zones and cultures, balancing global consistency with local relevance. Willingness to travel internationally as needed. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. title: Support Associate / Kundenservice (m/w/d) in Vollzeit (Englisch C1 und Deutsch C1)
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Du liebst es, dich mit anderen über Essen auszutauschen? Du verstehst es, auf authentische Art mit Menschen umzugehen und verbreitest gern gute Laune? Fühlst du dich wohl in einem jungen und internationalen Team – dann bist du bei Wolt genau richtig. Wir freuen uns, von dir zu hören! 🚀

Der Job

Wir suchen Support Associates in Vollzeit und Teilzeit für unser Team in Berlin-Friedrichshain.

Du bist Teil der Live-Operation, schreibst mit allen Wolt Usern - Kunden, Kurieren oder Restaurants - und sorgst so für den besten Support, den sich hungrige Menschen wünschen können. 

Du willst bei uns mitmischen? Dann solltest du folgendes mitbringen:

  • Customer Obsession: Wir wollen unseren Kunden mehr bieten, als einfach nur Probleme zu lösen. Jede Unterhaltung hat die Möglichkeit eine unvergessliche Erfahrung zu werden.
  • Team Player: Du arbeitest in einem Team mit internationalem Touch. Unsere Live Operation ist der Kleber, der alles zusammenhält. Damit stehst du in engem Austausch mit unseren weiteren Teams.
  • Persönlich und kommunikativ: Du triffst bei jedem Gesprächspartner den richtigen Ton und kannst auf kreative Weise sympathisch reagieren.
  • Attitude: Du übernimmst Verantwortung, gehst deine Arbeit vorausschauend an und hast immer das große Ganze im Blick.

 

  • Du sprichst und schreibst sowohl Deutsch als auch Englisch fließend auf C1-Niveau
  • Es handelt sich um eine Stelle mit Schichtdienst. Du kannst morgens, abends und auch an Wochenenden arbeiten – Wolt steht seinen Kunden sieben Tage die Woche zur Verfügung 
  • Du hast bereits Erfahrungen in kundenorientierten Jobs gesammelt
  • Du hast eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe, ein Auge fürs Detail und verlierst dabei nie das große Ganze aus dem Blick
  • Du bist tech-savvy, kannst schnell tippen, und interessierst dich für digitale Produkte

Aktuell suchen wir Support Associates in Vollzeit und Teilzeit für unser Team.

Wir stellen ein, sobald wir die passenden Kandidaten gefunden haben, warte also besser nicht zu lange und bewirb dich am besten noch heute! Fülle einfach das Formular und die Fragen am Ende dieser Seite aus. Wir werden uns dann in wenigen Tagen bei dir melden.

Was wir dir bieten: 

  • Ein cooles Büro im Herzen von Berlin
  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell 
  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten in einem dynamischen, internationalen Team
  • Ein schnell wachsendes Tech-Unternehmen mit vielen Karrieremöglichkeiten 
  • Attraktives Gehaltspaket
  • Rabatt auf Wolt-Bestellungen
  • Modernes Arbeitsequipment 
  • Diverse Softdrinks, Kaffee und Obst im Büro
  • Umfassende interne Weiterbildungen
  • Regelmäßige All-Hands-Meetings und Team-Events
  • 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub
  • Flexible Arbeitszeitregelungen 

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: People Relations Specialist
description: A World-Changing Company Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. The Role As a People Relations Specialist, you will partner with our Employment Counsel, People Partners, and the business to address, navigate, and productively manage people issues surrounding conduct, performance, and culture. You will be responsible for running workplace investigations end-to-end and will partner with Employment Counsel, People Partners, and Business Leaders on owning outcomes and closing out cases in a manner consistent with our culture and business values. In addition to resolving investigations and complaints, and determining appropriate disciplinary actions, you will also provide pragmatic HR advice and assist the broader People Team with other employment issues and cross-functional efforts that shape our culture, values, and offerings. Core Responsibilities Lead all aspects of People Relations cases, including: Partnering with People Partners and Employment Counsel on investigation strategy and risk assessment. Conducting interviews, preparing reports, and owning investigation outcomes and close out. Tracking and preparing status updates, coordinating input from multiple team members; and advising and overseeing disciplinary and remediation actions. Support sophisticated and/or nuanced people focused discussions around topics like performance, team dynamics, cultural topics, etc. Develop programs and training and policy content on People Relations issues and host regular training sessions for employees. Partner with People Team to create data-driven solutions that highlight employee relations trends and advise decision-making. Partner with People Partners and other internal leaders on people focused programs that ensure our employee population is supported to do their best work. Contribute to internal and external audits / projects relating to HR and compliance policies and practices. What We Value Ability to operate with empathy and work toward de-escalation of challenging and/or intense conversations. Ability to navigate nuanced situations, calibrate with stakeholders, and display good judgement. Ability to model respectful and conscientious behavior in difficult and uncomfortable situations surrounding an investigation. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with ability to deal with critical matters and establish and build trust in cross-functional relationships. Ability to work independently, stay highly organised, and prioritise a number of matters efficiently. What We Require 3+ years of experience in employee relations in an Employee Relations Specialist, HR Business Partner, or equivalent role. Validated knowledge of HR processes and US & UK employment laws. Background in other international jurisdictions a plus. Ability to build trust with a variety of stakeholders, understand business context and strategy, and navigate nuanced org structures. Experience in conducting workplace concern intake meetings, investigations, and conflict resolution. Experience in building out Employee Relations processes and best practices. Excellent written and verbal communication technique and style in the area of workplace concerns and investigation. Excellent writing, presentation, and training skills. Strong analytical and problem solving ability. Background in the tech sector and/or with sales organisations is a plus. Ability to travel occasionally.

title: Head of Solutions Architecture, EMEA
description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the role

We are looking for a Head of Solutions Architecture, EMEA to join our global Field Engineering organization. You will build and lead the technical sales organization behind our customer relationships across Europe, a region where some of the most ambitious web and AI products are being built on Vercel, Next.js, and our AI stack. The architecture decisions our Solutions Architects shape early, in the first review and the first migration plan, often determine how far a customer scales with us.

You will lead the Solutions Architecture organization across EMEA, a team of Solutions Architects and the managers who lead them. You will set the bar for technical excellence across the deal cycle, coach the team through strategic accounts and critical deals, and step in yourself when it matters most: architecture reviews, migration plans, and high-stakes executive presentations. You will shape how Vercel wins in the region, turning patterns from the field into repeatable plays, adapting our motion to the realities of selling across European markets, and carrying what customers tell you back to our product and engineering teams so it shows up in the platform. You will drive org planning, staffing, budgeting, and recruiting as you scale the team the region needs, partner closely with EMEA Sales leadership to win new business and expand existing accounts, and report directly to our Global VP of Field Engineering.

 

This is a hybrid position based in our London or Berlin office, with three days per week onsite.

What you'll do

  • Lead, develop, and manage our team of pre- and post-sales Solutions Architects across EMEA.
  • Provide hands-on support for key accounts as needed (presentations, architecture reviews, migration plans).
  • Oversee and coach Solutions Architects on strategic accounts and other engagements across segments.
  • Partner with our engineering org to provide product feedback from the field.
  • Develop repeatable plays from trends you are seeing across your team.
  • Track and report SA performance to Sales and Field Engineering leadership quarterly.
  • Own org planning, staffing, budgeting, and regional recruiting.

What you need

  • 10+ years of experience in Solutions Architect, Sales Engineering, or Technical Pre-sales roles, with at least 5 years in a leadership position.
  • Strong background in modern web technologies (JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, APIs, cloud infrastructure).
  • Proven ability to lead, coach, and scale technical teams in a high-growth environment.
  • Demonstrated success working with enterprise and commercial customers across diverse industries.
  • Strong understanding of modern software development workflows (CI/CD, DevOps, frontend frameworks, etc.).
  • Experience collaborating with Sales, Product, and Engineering teams to drive customer success.

Bonus if you

  • Have hands-on experience building with Vercel, Next.js, or similar frontend frameworks.
  • Have led SA teams at a high-growth SaaS or cloud infrastructure company.
  • Bring expertise in developer tooling, edge computing, or performance optimization.
  • Are comfortable presenting at conferences, webinars, or large-scale customer events.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation package, including equity.
  • Inclusive Healthcare Package.
  • Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.

title: Manager - Tax Data Analytics Engineer
location: Berlin, Germany; Helsinki, Finland; London, United Kingdom
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

We are looking for an experienced Data Analytics Engineer to join our growing Tax Data Mart team. This role will be a key contributor to the team and will be responsible for building the tax data operations function for our Deliveroo and Wolt legal entities.  This includes building and operating the data pipelines and infrastructure that power tax analytics and support decision-making across the company.

As DoorDash continues to grow its global footprint across multiple business lines, we are looking for a candidate with experience working with Tax teams to gather requirements, and designing scalable data processes to support them.. This person will grow our unique community via your blend of tax, data technology, and process improvement experience.

About the Role

You will be reporting to the Senior Manager of Tax Data & Operations, and play an integral role in DoorDash’s data function, owning the processes for ingesting, transforming, and controlling our data, ensuring accuracy, and making it available to analytics and business users.

As a member of this team, you will lead the design, implementation, and operation of data pipelines and related processes to support the Company’s exponential growth.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead the collection of Tax Data and Reporting requirements through close relationships with Tax team counterparts
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines (ETL/ELT) that serve data across the company
  • Develop and optimize data models and warehouse structures to support analytics and reporting
  • Participate in new business initiatives and identify their impact on existing data system(s) and processes.
  • Work closely with Analytics, Data Science, and business partners in the development and validation of new data sources.
  • Identify and document business, functional and technical requirements to support new business initiatives and to enhance existing system functionality.
  • Leverage AI & AI assisted tooling to build and automate recurring data tasks & pipelines.
  • Monitor data quality, reliability, and observability, and resolve data-related issues for our internal business partners.
  • Participate in defining the Company’s data tooling needs, including the maintenance of existing systems.
  • Prepare documentation related to our data systems and processes.
  • Share knowledge and best practices with engineers and analysts across the team.

Our humble expectations

  • You have 7+ years of experience in a Tax data & technology or similar role.
  • Experience using Data Build Tool (DBT) or a similar product to manage data flows.
  • Experience using Claude, Cursor and similar AI tools.
  • You are an expert at using SQL with experience using Snowflake.
  • Proficiency in Python (or a comparable language) for building data pipelines.
  • Experience with modern data stack and orchestration tools such as Airflow, Spark, or Kafka.
  • You have strong attention to detail and analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • You’re an independently motivated person with a proven ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize work independently.
  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Project management experience, including creation of project plans, milestones, and due dates.
  • Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related degree.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Senior Product Designer, Platform (Geospatial)
description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:  

The design team at Planet is looking for a Senior Product Designer to shape Planet's platform experience (insights.planet.com - free trial available). In this role, you will be responsible for defining the core user journeys across our platform, addressing the needs of different user types (from admins, to developers, to end users). With a relentless focus on those users, you will define jobs-to-be-done and design end-to-end user flows across web frontends and agentic workflows. You will collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to decompose these workflows into scalable, reusable UX building blocks, ultimately crafting a cohesive, user-centric platform experience.

The perfect candidate brings a track record of designing sophisticated, data-heavy geospatial applications. This role is full stack, in the design sense: you take a problem from discovery with users all the way to designing and building the interfaces, side by side with our engineers. 

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin or Haarlem office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Product Design Ownership: Lead the end-to-end process from discovery and prototyping to high-fidelity design.
  • Geospatial Interface Design: Create intuitive, powerful geospatial interfaces that translate complex data into actionable insights. 
  • User Research: Gather feedback and conduct user interviews in close collaboration with product partners.
  • UI Architecture: Define and architect the interaction patterns and design system for Planet’s platform.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with product and engineering to ensure top-tier design quality.
  • Culture: Help build and elevate Planet's design culture.

What You Bring:

  • 6+ years designing complex digital products, with a track record of shipping technical, SaaS, or B2B software end to end. 
  • Bachelor’s degree in design or an equivalent field.
  • A portfolio with geospatial or data analytics work: interactive maps, layered geospatial data and time series (time sliders, change over time, comparisons), plus the statistics and charts that turn data into an insight. 
  • Solid core craft in UX/UI, interaction design, prototyping, accessibility, and visual design, plus Figma and enterprise design systems.
  • An AI-native way of working. You can prototype in code with AI coding assistants, and you're comfortable with Git and merge requests. 
  • Research you run yourself: user interviews and usability testing, synthesized into clear product direction.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. You take vague, complex problems and drive them to a validated solution without daily oversight.
  • A dynamic, iterative, low-ego way of working with PMs, engineers, and other designers.

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Experience designing for developers, data scientists, or AI agents.
  • Hands-on with remote sensing analysis and familiarity with geospatial standards.
  • You enjoy meeting customers and are open to travel within Europe.
  • Experience helping a team adopt new ways of working.

Application Deadline:

11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.

Benefits While Working at Planet:

These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.

  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off 
  • Employee Wellness Program 
  • Home Office Reimbursement
  • Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement
  • Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning
  • Equity 
  • Volunteering Paid Time Off

Compensation:

The expected starting gross salary range for this role is listed below. Individual placement within this range is determined objectively based on gender-neutral criteria such as your skills, qualifications, and professional experience. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses and/or equity.

Germany Salary Range
€77.000—€96.300 EUR

San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance
Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Why we care so much about Belonging. 
We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work.  If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply!  At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description.  We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts.  We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride.

Planet is committed to building a community where everyone belongs and we invite people from all backgrounds to apply. Planet is an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. title: Grocery Associate
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Hľadáme parťákov a parťáčky do prevádzky Wolt Marketu na plný úväzok! 💪🏻

Wolt Market je členom Wolt platformy. Máme vlastné kamenné výdajne, ale zákazník sa k nám nedostane - nakúpi si online cez Wolt aplikáciu. My objednávku spracujeme a odovzdáme do rúk kuriéra, ktorý sa postará o jej rýchle doručenie.

Sme super kolektív, radi sa spolu smejeme, riešime čokoľvek, čo sa na mieste stane a práca nám nie je cudzia. 🩵

Ak preferujete samostatnú prácu bez komunikácie so zákazníkmi, táto pozícia je priamo pre Vás.

Čo budeš mať na starosti:

  • Spracovanie objednávok cez našu aplikáciu "Merchant"
  • Pripravovanie a balenie potravín
  • Odovzdávanie objednávok zákazníkom a kuriérom
  • Prijímanie a vykladanie tovaru
  • Denný kontakt s dodávateľmi a kuriérmi
  • Kontrola kvality potravín
  • Udržiavanie poriadku a čistoty v predajni

Naše skromné očakávania:

  • Rýchlo sa učíš a multitasking ti nie je cudzí
  • Máš proaktívny, prozákaznícky, jednoducho „can-do“ prístup
  • Poradíš si s technikou (vieš používať smartphone a notebook) 
  • Si motivovaný a flexibilný človek - práca v rýchlo sa meniacom prostredí
  • Máš ambíciu rásť a rozvíjať sa
  • Vieš plynule slovensky slovom aj písmom (B2/C1)
  • Máš základy angličtiny (pre navigáciu v našich systémoch)

Na čo sa môžeš tešiť:

  • Plat 5.80 EUR/hod (prve 3 mesiace), 6.30 EUR/hod (po skusobnej dobe)
  • Možnosť kariérneho rastu
  • Občerstvenie na pracovisku 
  • Priateľské pracovné prostredie 
  • Flexibilné pracovné smeny 
  • Prácu v rastúcej medzinárodnej spoločnosti

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Platform Hiring Partner
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

The Platform Hiring Team (PHT) is building a centralized, technology-enabled hiring engine for repeatable, high-volume roles across supported DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt businesses.

You'll join Platform Hiring Operations, PHT's business-facing team. This team owns demand, market context, and pipeline health: translating business needs into hiring plans, keeping stakeholders ahead of risk, and clearing blockers before they reach the execution team.

About the Role

You'll own business readiness, attraction, and pipeline health for Wolt Market across the North region. You'll translate business needs into hiring plans, validate demand against strategy and cost, coordinate Marketing and sourcing partners, activate roles when requirements are complete, and monitor progress against hiring dates.

You'll advise business leaders on hiring strategy, market conditions, timing, location, quality, and delivery trade-offs using funnel and talent-market evidence. When pipeline volume declines, you'll coordinate targeted sourcing interventions and ensure the execution team has sufficient pipeline. You'll proactively coordinate blockers across onboarding, background checks, training capacity, HR, and local operations.

You'll identify recurring friction and work with the Platform Hiring Manager and PM Team on scalable improvements, automation, and AI adoption. You'll own market and business exceptions that require context beyond the standard platform workflow and maintain clear stakeholder communication and portfolio documentation.

You're excited about this opportunity because ..

  • Own the business partnership for Wolt Market hiring across the North region.
  • Collect, validate, and translate hiring demand against workforce strategy, timing, and cost expectations.
  • Set up approved headcount and role requirements in the active hiring platform.
  • Own relationships with Marketing, Employer Brand, and sourcing partners for top-of-funnel strategy.
  • Use historical funnel performance to establish the sourcing and application volume required for delivery.
  • Activate roles with the Platform Hiring team and maintain clear handoffs, service expectations, and priorities.
  • Monitor pipeline health, conversion, drop-off, and hiring dates and provide proactive business updates.
  • Advise business leaders on hiring strategy, attraction, market conditions, location, timing, quality, and delivery trade-offs using funnel and talent-market evidence.
  • Deploy targeted sourcing interventions or coordinate specialist sourcing support when pipeline volume declines.
  • Partner with low-volume recruiting teams and business leaders where work crosses operating-model boundaries.
  • Coordinate blockers across onboarding, background checks, training capacity, HR, and local operations.
  • Own market and business exceptions that require context beyond the standard platform workflow.
  • Support approved candidate-facing exceptions, including local-language communication, offer delivery, or low-volume work, while maintaining the standard platform workflow wherever possible.
  • Escalate recurring friction with evidence, volume, impact, and a recommended path to resolution.
  • Identify automation and AI use cases, adopt approved solutions, and track their effect on manual work and decision speed.
  • Maintain accurate portfolio documentation, decisions, risks, and source-of-truth reporting.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of the Platform Hiring operating model through practical feedback and evidence from the Wolt Market portfolio.

We're excited about you because

  • You have 5+ years of experience in full-cycle recruiting, high-volume hiring, recruiting operations, or a consultative program role.
  • You have 3+ years of experience working with, managing, and influencing stakeholders across functions.
  • You have experience translating hiring demand into practical hiring plans and coordinating sourcing, conversion, offers, and onboarding dependencies.
  • You are comfortable owning a defined business portfolio and proactively managing its hiring risks and priorities.
  • You have confidence using hiring data and funnel performance to challenge assumptions and recommend action.
  • You communicate clearly and proactively, with strong business judgment and a focus on candidate experience.
  • You can coordinate effectively across Operations, HR, Workforce Planning, Marketing, Employer Brand, and Learning and Development.
  • You're comfortable with Fountain, Greenhouse, dashboards, workflow automation, continuous improvement, and light program management.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Senior Search Backend Engineer (m/f/x)
description:
About commercetools

Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people.

Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers.The kind of people who not only pioneered a more flexible approach to commerce architecture but also shaped the culture of experimentation that approach unlocked. Together, they are the engine of commerce innovation today.

At commercetools, we power the next era of commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits.

Here, the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce but to build your own.

Your Impact

As a Senior Search Engineer on our Discovery Team, you will build the retrieval layer behind product discovery for some of the world’s most demanding commerce brands.

Search is changing shape. Shoppers type full sentences instead of keywords, and increasingly the client calling our API is an AI agent rather than a person. We are on the path to take our semantic and hybrid retrieval to general availability, and tackling the hard problems: making it fast, affordable, measurably better across enterprise catalogs, and working out what comes after it. You would join that work at every layer, from query understanding down to the vector index and the cost of a single query.

You will:

  • Design and implement search functionalities in a PaaS ecommerce Scala backend
  • Develop search capabilities that combine lexical, semantic, and hybrid retrieval
  • Develop search-related libraries based on ElasticSearch and MongoDB
  • Contribute to search relevance and quality, and to how we measure it
  • Run and maintain a scalable search “infrastructure as code” on top of Kubernetes using terraform and multi-tenant architecture
  • Test software components regarding usability, functionality, and performance, and work closely with Product Management and DevOps
  • Learn Scala and functional programming as your new main development tools
  • Take part in on-call rotation with a worldwide distributed team for production systems

This role is hybrid, with three days a week spent in our Munich, Berlin, London or Valencia office. 

What Sets You Apart

You're a creative problem-solver who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork.

Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work. You do not need to be an ML researcher for this role. You need to be a strong backend engineer who is genuinely interested in retrieval quality.

You bring:

  • At least 5 years of experience as a Software Engineer, with production experience on the JVM
  • Solid understanding of parallel and asynchronous programming, as well as non-blocking I/O
  • Experience developing REST APIs and knowledge of scalable architectures, including sharding, replication, load balancing, and failover
  • Interest in working with Scala using pragmatic functional programming patterns. If you come from another JVM language, we will support you in picking it up.
  • Fluent English for work in international teams
  • Experience operating multi-tenant SaaS where one tenant’s load must never affect another’s
  • Knowledge of scalable event-driven architectures, including queues and notification topics
  • A genuine curiosity for using AI tools to work smarter and more effectively, paired with a drive to learn and put them into practice in your role.

Nice to Have: 

  • Hands-on search experience, preferably ElasticSearch or OpenSearch, including a working understanding of how an inverted index scores and ranks documents
  • Practical exposure to vector retrieval, such as embeddings, approximate nearest neighbor indexes, and hybrid ranking, and a sense of where each approach breaks down. A deep lexical search background plus a clear appetite to go into this territory also works.
  • Comfort reasoning about relevance with data, including precision and recall tradeoffs, ranking metrics, and behavioral signals
  • Experience with infrastructure work and other technologies like Helm, Kubernetes, and Rust

Our Benefits

Because work and life are connected, our benefits are too. We’ve designed them to give you the security, flexibility, and opportunities you need to focus on what matters most.

🩺 Comprehensive health benefits for you and your dependents, including access to OpenUp for personalized mental health support

📚 Learning and development opportunities including an annual learning budget, access to self-paced learning platforms and language training, personalized coaching, mentorship, and leadership programs

🍼 Family Leave Plus gives you additional fully paid weeks of parental leave on top of government-provided leave, so you can spend more time with your new addition

📈 Our equity participation program allows you to share in our success 

For more information on our benefits, visit this page.

Come as you are. Build with us.

Your unique perspective is essential to our success. We are committed to building a team that reflects the world around us because we know it’s the only way to build the future. We celebrate our differences and have created a hiring process that’s fair, inclusive, and designed to let your talent shine.

We proudly welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, and any other part of your identity that makes you who you are. As an equal opportunity employer, we believe that our strength lies in our diversity, and we invite you to be a part of our global community. 

For more information on our diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging practices, visit this page.

title: Content Designer II
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

At Affirm, we’re reimagining how people access and experience financial products. Our commitment to clarity, honesty, and empathy fuels every design decision across all of our user experiences. We’re looking for a Content Designer II to help create clear, useful, trustworthy, and compelling product experiences that make it easier for people to understand and use Affirm.

 

About the team

In this role, you’ll work as an embedded partner on a product team, collaborating closely with Product Design, Research, Product Management, Engineering, Brand, Legal, Compliance, and Customer Experience. You’ll help design and improve product experiences from discovery through launch, experimentation, and optimization, with a focus on both thoughtful content strategy and precise UX writing.

You’ll bring strong writing skills, customer empathy, and product thinking to important product work. You’ll ask thoughtful questions, explain your rationale clearly, and advocate for simple, transparent experiences that help customers make informed decisions. You’ll use content strategy, systems thinking, and UX writing to help teams create experiences that are simple, transparent, and customer-centered.

You’ll also contribute to Affirm’s growing Content Design practice by sharing feedback, participating in team rituals, helping strengthen guidelines and patterns, and partnering with other content designers. This role is ideal for a collaborative, curious, and customer-oriented content designer who is ready to grow their craft while making meaningful contributions to product experiences.


What You’ll Do

  • Contribute content design to product work, shaping user flows, information architecture, content hierarchy, UX writing, and customer communications across web and native app experiences.

  • Work cross-functionally with Product Design, Research, Product Management, Engineering, Brand, Legal, Compliance, and Customer Experience from early ideas through launch and optimization.

  • Help teams understand customer problems, identify content and usability opportunities, and make thoughtful decisions about how product experiences should work and communicate.

  • Write clear, accurate, concise, and human product content across in-product flows, notifications, emails, text messages, prototypes, and other customer touchpoints.

  • Use research, experimentation, customer feedback, and data to improve content decisions, usability, and customer understanding.

  • Participate in design sprints, critique, content reviews, and product discussions as an advocate for clarity, accessibility, and content-first design.

  • Help strengthen Affirm’s content design practice by contributing to style guides, writing guidelines, reusable patterns, team artifacts, and shared ways of working.


What We Look For

  • 2+ years of experience in content design, UX writing, content strategy, information architecture, or a related field, with experience designing for web and native digital products.

  • A portfolio that shows strong UX writing craft, strategic thinking, and shipped product experiences across in-app, web, or other customer touchpoints.

  • Strong understanding of UX writing, information architecture, content hierarchy, usability, accessibility, research, experimentation, and product development.

  • Ability to work independently on defined projects, navigate ambiguity with support, connect content decisions to customer needs and business goals, and move work forward with care.

  • Experience collaborating with PMs, designers, researchers, engineers, legal, compliance, marketing, or brand partners to shape clear and effective product experiences.

  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain rationale, invite feedback, build alignment, and advocate for the customer.

  • Nice to have: experience in financial services, regulated industries, native app experiences, design systems, lifecycle communications, or AI-enabled content workflows.

Compensation & Benefits

Base Pay Grade: J

Equity Grade: UK 4

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness, and tech spending, and benefits including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental, and vision for you and your dependents. In addition, employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc.

GBR base pay range per year: £80,000 - 118,000

Location: Remote UK

#LI-Remote

Remote-first with flexibility built in
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

title: Medical Data Intern (x/f/m)
description:
Medical Data Intern (x/f/m)

Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Medical Data Intern to join the Terminology and Ontology team within the Medical Excellence department at Doctolib in Berlin.

 

At Doctolib, we're setting a new pulse for healthcare. We create AI-powered solutions that help health professionals focus on care and help people prevent, detect, and treat health problems earlier. In this role, you will contribute to making medical information clear, structured, and usable across products for patients, healthcare professionals, and technical teams.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Collect and format sets of terms describing pathologies, allergies, treatments, and other medical concepts, based on standard medical terminologies such as ICD-10 and SNOMED CT.
  • Adapt medical labels to create versions that are understandable to patients and healthcare professionals.
  • Translate labels from English into German.
  • Map medical lists of terms across different products.
  • Select and filter terms, then validate your choices with medical experts.
  • Share your work and methodology with the Terminology and Ontology team and product teams.
  • Deliver sets of terms to technical teams in the correct format.



About our data environment

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to the country and healthcare specialty requirements.
  • Our stack is composed of Dagster, dbt, Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, and other technologies.
  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here and learn about our first AI hackathon here!

If you would like to find out more about tech life at Doctolib, feel free to read our latest Medium blog articles!

Who you are

Before you read on, if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You could be our next teammate if:

  • You have medical skills gained through a diploma or degree that includes medical-domain learning.
  • You have knowledge of data management.
  • You are familiar with medical terminologies such as ICD-10 and SNOMED CT.
  • You have strong spreadsheet skills, including Google Sheets or Excel and the use of formulas. 
  • You are attentive to detail and demonstrate rigour in your work.
  • You speak German and English, which is a must have for this role.

Nice to have:

  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude.
  • Python programming skills.
  • Additional depth of medical knowledge.
  • Dutch language skills.

 

What we offer

  • A structured and personalized onboarding program through our Doctolib Academy, as well as a wide range of in-house training opportunities and masterclasses throughout the internship.
  • Regular breakfast in the office and subsidies for your lunch or grocery shopping.
  • A Deutschlandticket sponsored by Doctolib, or reimbursement of your semester ticket.
  • A flexible workplace policy offering up to 2 days of hybrid work per week.

 

The interview process

  • An interview with our Talent Partner (30 minutes).
  • An interview with the hiring manager (30 minutes).

Job details

  • Contract Type: Internship (Mandatory/Voluntary)
  • Working Time: Full-time
  • Duration: 6 months
  • Work model: Hybrid
  • Location: Berlin, Germany.
  • Expected start date: January 2027

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This commitment is reflected in our hiring process, where we assess applications based solely on qualifications, potential, and motivation, without discrimination of any kind.

We believe that diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences help us build better healthcare products. We welcome applications from all candidates, regardless of gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To support equal opportunities, we encourage candidates not to include unnecessary personal information, such as a photo or age, in their application. If you need any accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know and we will do our best to support you.

Data privacy

All information provided is processed by Doctolib for application management. For data processing details, click here. Please contact hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com for inquiries or to exercise your rights.

title: Benefits Analyst
description:
What is Box?

Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

Why Box needs you:

We are seeking an experienced Benefits Analyst based in Poland to join our International Total Rewards team. With a growing employee population in Poland and a range of locally specific benefits and leave processes, Box needs dedicated in-country expertise to deliver reliable operational support, ensure statutory compliance, and provide an exceptional Box-on-Box experience.

In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for Poland benefits and support leave administration while supporting broader EMEA/APAC initiatives. You will report to the Senior Team Manager and partner closely with People Partners, Payroll, Legal, Finance, and external vendors to deliver accurate, timely, and compliant benefits operations. You will also help identify opportunities to automate, simplify, document, and standardise processes.

What you'll do: 

  • Take day-to-day ownership of Poland benefits administration, acting as a key point of contact for Poland-based Boxers and managers on benefits eligibility, enrollment, policies and local programs.

  • Manage Benefits Service Desk cases through to resolution within agreed service levels, coordinating responses across Jira, email and Slack and escalating complex queries appropriately.

  • Support the full Boxer lifecycle, including benefits administration for new hires, employee changes and leavers, and deliver benefits induction sessions.

  • Provide trained administrative backup to the Leave of Absence Manager for Poland sickness, maternity, parental and other statutory and company-provided leave, maintaining accurate Workday records, trackers and supporting documentation.

  • Support routine employee and manager communications throughout the leave lifecycle, coordinating with People Operations, People Partners and Payroll, while escalating complex cases and return-to-work questions to the LOA Manager and relevant specialists.

  • Act as the Benefits team backup for the ZUS platform, supporting the reconciliation of statutory sickness and absence information with internal HR and payroll records.

  • Coordinate with benefit providers and vendors on enrollments, invoices, reconciliations, employee changes and issue resolution.

  • Support assigned EMEA/APAC benefits programs, including medical, risk insurance, pension, wellbeing and other local benefits, alongside primary responsibility for Poland operations.

  • Prepare and validate recurring benefits reports, vendor files and Workday uploads, including LuxMed files and assigned payroll, pension and leave-related reporting.

  • Partner with Payroll and Finance to deliver accurate benefits-related payroll inputs, invoice processing and reconciliations within agreed deadlines.

  • Maintain accurate benefits data across Workday, vendor platforms and internal records, completing regular audits, investigating discrepancies and coordinating corrections.

  • Coordinate Poland open enrollment and support all EMEA/APAC annual benefits renewals, maintaining timelines, employee communications, enrollment checks and follow-up actions. Support market reviews and benchmarking through data gathering and coordination with brokers and vendors.

  • Maintain benefits policies, FAQs, employee communications and process guides, documenting key controls, deadlines, ownership and escalation routes. Participate in cross-training and test backup procedures for critical activities.

  • Support reviews of relevant legislative and taxation changes with Benefits leadership and appropriate specialists, helping implement approved updates to processes and employee guidance.

  • Track service volumes, query themes, backlog and administrative effort, contributing to reporting that helps the team prioritize work, understand capacity and identify recurring issues.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate benefits and leave processes using approved technology and AI tools, partnering with People Operations, Payroll and Enterprise Systems to test improvements and measure their impact.

  • Support the implementation of new or enhanced benefits programs, including testing, data validation, employee communications and operational handover, and contribute to wider EMEA/APAC Benefits projects as required.

 

Who you are:

We are an AI-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box.

  • Bachelor’s degree in HR, Finance, Business Administration, or equivalent practical experience, with 2–4+ years of hands-on benefits administration experience (preferably in a multinational technology or shared-services environment).

  • Solid understanding of Total Rewards fundamentals, statutory benefits, and leave administration (including Polish sickness, parental, and statutory absence practices; familiarity with ZUS, PPK, and local insured benefits is a strong advantage).

  • Professional fluency in both English and Polish (written and verbal) is required to navigate local-language portals, statutory documentation, and vendor relationships.

  • Hands-on experience with Workday is required; advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets (formulas, pivot tables, audits, and reconciliations) with rigorous attention to data accuracy.

  • Proven ability to partner effectively with external brokers/insurers (renewals, invoicing, escalations) and internal teams (Payroll, People Operations, Legal, and Finance).

  • Proven ability to manage recurring operational activities and resolve issues using established processes.

  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • Comfortable working with sensitive employee information and maintaining confidentiality.

  • Self-starter with a passion for process optimization, documenting workflows, and identifying opportunities to simplify, automate, or scale manual operations.

 

BENEFITS
Check out the overview of Life at Box which include general perks and benefits.

Box lives its values, with community and in-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week. Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.

At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in. If you are head-over-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, and any other protected ground of discrimination under applicable human rights legislation.

For details on how we protect your information when you apply, please see our Personnel Privacy Notice.

For more details on how Box Poland protects your information, please see our Supplemental Personnel and Candidate Privacy Notice.

title: Forward Deployed Infrastructure Engineer - UK Government
description: A World-Changing Company Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. The Role We’re looking for Forward Deployed Infrastructure Engineers who can help us build, operate, and maintain high-performance, scalable, and reliable services for Palantir platforms, products, and deployments. You'll get to use your creativity to develop novel solutions to evolving challenges and automate processes wherever possible, using whichever tools are best for the job including industry-leading LLM and AI technology! As a Forward Deployed Infrastructure Engineer, every day is different! description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Si timski/-ka igralec/-ka z odličnimi komunikacijskimi sposobnostmi? Uživaš v delu v dinamičnem okolju? Če je tvoj odgovor pritrdilen - potem beri naprej! 

Trenutno iščemo nove sodelavce za polni delovni čas za podporo uporabnikom, ki se bodo pridružili naši ekipi v pisarni v Ljubljani! Delo je izmensko in poteka vsak dan med 06:45 in 01:00 (tudi med vikendi in prazniki). Tako lahko ti in tvoji sodelavci v tem časovnem okviru našim uporabnikom kadarkoli zagotavljate vrhunske storitve!

Kaj bo obsegalo tvoje delo

  • Najboljša podpora uporabnikom in partnerjem na svetu: Naše poslanstvo v podjetju Wolt je, da strankam vsakič znova zagotovimo nepozabno izkušnjo. Kar delamo, je več kot le odpravljanje težav.
  • Usmerjenost v ekipno delo: Delo z raznoliko ekipo sodelavcev za podporo uporabnikom in sodelovanje z drugimi člani naše ekipe, z namenom komuniciranja in odpravljanja morebitnih težav, tudi tehničnih, ali v povezavi z drugimi možnimi vprašanji, ki se lahko pojavijo tekom tvoje izmene. 
  • Komunikacija: Tekoče in nemoteno komuniciranje z našimi uporabniki in partnerji ter ustrezno prilagajanje tona komunikacije potrebam vsakega posameznika.
  • Osebna nota: V naših interakcijah se ne bojimo biti igrivi, zato je ustvarjalnost obvezna!
  • Osredotočenost k doseganju ciljev: Osredotočenost na izpolnjevanje nalog in skrb, da so le-te odlično opravljene.

Kvalifikacije

  • Tekoče govoriš in pišeš slovensko in angleško.
  • Imaš že nekaj izkušenj na primerljivem delovnem mestu in se veseliš dela v naši nagrajeni ekipi za podporo uporabnikom.
  • Hitro se učiš in si pozoren/-na tako na majhne podrobnosti kot tudi na širšo sliko.
  • Večopravilnost je tvoja močna točka in lahko brez problema obvladaš več interakcij hkrati, pri čemer zlahka določiš, katere so prednostne.
  • Pripravljen/-a si zavihati rokave in se lotiti dela v hitro rastočem zagonskem okolju.

Kaj nudimo

  • Najmanj 25 dni dopusta - letno (only full-time)
  • Dodatni dnevi plačanega dopusta za pomembne privatne zadeve (only full-time)
  • Wolt krediti - uživaj v Woltovih dostavah na dom in ob vsakem dostavljenem naročilu na tvoj Wolt uporabniški račun v obliki Wolt kreditov prejmi povrnjen delež celotnega naročila
  • Hibridni način dela - ko začneš delati samostojno, je delo na daljavo mogoče (ob vikendih, praznikih, popoldanskih in izbranih jutranjih izmenah)
  • Program pomoči zaposlenim - naša interna Wolt izobraževanja, personalizirani trening programi in učni viri
  • Wolt-wide programi izobraževanja - koristne informacije in svetovanje na različnih področjih in o številnih tematikah namenjeno ne le tebi, temveč tudi tvojim najbližjim in najdražjim
  • Letni budget - namenjen večerjam in aktivnostim v krogu tvojih sodelavcev
  • Sadje in pijača v pisarni

Če si navdušen/-a nad delom v hitro rastočem zagonskem okolju in v izjemno ambiciozni ekipi ter ti prevzemanje odgovornosti ne predstavlja problema, klikni spodaj in se prijavi, pri čemer ne pozabi na svoj življenjepis.  Intervju bo potekal v živo na lokaciji pisarne. Se slišimo! :)

 

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Sales Manager (Trójmiasto)
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

At Wolt, you can grow your sales career with a fun and fast-scaling global business. Part of the DoorDash team, we’re building a global logistics platform that can deliver (almost) everything in your city, to your door in minutes. Today, our products are used by 55+ million registered users who can now order from 200,000+ restaurants and retail stores across 30+ countries around the world. 

Our Sales teams create and build our relationships with merchants. Together, we’ve helped big brands, local stores and neighborhood restaurants do over €15 billion’s worth of business through our platform. We’re constantly launching new cities and products, so there are always new opportunities to expand your skills and progress your career. 

What you’ll be doing

Wolt has been growing rapidly in Poland ever since we entered the market in 2018. We’re now in 25 cities and continue to expand fast - with even more exciting growth ahead. 

As we strengthen our presence in northern Poland, we’re looking for an experienced and driven Sales Manager based in Gdańsk, Gdynia or Sopot to take the lead in driving restaurant and retail acquisition and growth in the region. This is a key commercial role, where you’ll not only drive new partnerships with top-tier Merchants but also shape Wolt’s overall acquisition strategy in Poland.

You’ll work closely with our Account Management team to ensure we’re building a high-quality, scalable Merchant base while maintaining Wolt’s signature focus on quality and service.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

  • Leading the end-to-end sales process for high-potential and strategic restaurant and retail partners - from prospecting to closing.
  • Identifying new business opportunities, market trends, and categories that can accelerate Wolt’s growth.
  • Managing and optimizing the sales pipeline, ensuring strong forecasting accuracy and data-driven decision-making.
  • Negotiating partnership terms with key stakeholders and ensuring long-term, profitable collaborations.
  • Partnering with cross-functional teams (Mx Services, Account Management and Marketing) to ensure smooth onboarding and lasting partner success.
  • Using insights from data to refine acquisition strategies and continuously improve sales effectiveness.

Our humble expectations

  • Proven experience in B2B sales, business development, or partnerships, ideally within the food delivery, hospitality, or FMCG industries.
  • Strong track record of closing high-value deals and managing strategic partnerships.
  • A strategic thinker who can translate insights into actionable business plans and execute with excellence.
  • Strong negotiation, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to influence at all levels.
  • A passion for great food and a deep understanding of the local restaurant and retail landscape.
  • Fluent in Polish and English.

Why you’ll love it

  • 🚀Global and growing fast: Be part of a fast-moving scaleup
  • 🤩Ride of a lifetime: Accelerate your career and build your sales skills 
  • 💪Instant impact: Take ownership and make a difference
  • 💙Big hearts and small egos: Surround yourself with smart, friendly people

Next steps

If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply, make sure to add your CV and get the conversation going! 

We will be reviewing applications on an on-going basis. If this sounds like an opportunity you want to pursue, apply today!  💙
